-- First, let's create a comprehensive view of what we'll do
WITH cas_stats AS (
    SELECT cas_number, MAX(quantity) as max_qty
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
),
dedup_plan AS (
    SELECT 
        r.lot_id,
        r.cas_number,
        r.name,
        r.lot_role,
        r.quantity,
        r.unit,
        r.location,
        r.received,
        r.notes,
        cs.max_qty,
        CASE WHEN r.quantity = cs.max_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_kept,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(del.lot_id, ', ')
         FROM reagents del
         WHERE del.cas_number = r.cas_number 
           AND del.lot_id != r.lot_id
           AND (del.quantity < (SELECT MAX(q) FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = del.cas_number)) OR
           (del.quantity = (SELECT MAX(q) FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = del.cas_number) AND del.lot_id < r.lot_id) OR
           (del.quantity = (SELECT MAX(q) FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = del.cas_number) AND del.lot_id > r.lot_id)
        ) as merged_lots
    FROM reagents r
    JOIN cas_stats cs ON r.cas_number = cs.cas_number
),
-- Identify which rows to keep and which to merge
rows_to_keep AS (
    SELECT lot_id 
    FROM reagents 
    WHERE quantity = (SELECT MAX(quantity) FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = reagents.cas_number),
    -- For ties, keep the one with the smallest lot_id (deterministic)
    OR (quantity != (SELECT MAX(quantity) FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = reagents.cas_number))
)
SELECT * FROM dedup_plan
WHERE is_kept = 1;

-- Find rows to keep (max quantity for each CAS, using lot_id as tiebreaker)
WITH cas_max AS (
    SELECT cas_number, MAX(quantity) as max_qty
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
)
SELECT r.lot_id, r.cas_number, r.quantity, cm.max_qty
FROM reagents r
JOIN cas_max cm ON r.cas_number = cm.cas_number
WHERE r.quantity = cm.max_qty;

-- Build the notes field with merged lots
WITH cas_max AS (
    SELECT cas_number, MAX(quantity) as max_qty
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
)
SELECT 
    r.lot_id,
    r.cas_number,
    r.quantity,
    cm.max_qty,
    -- Find all other lot_ids for this CAS that should be merged into this row
    GROUP_CONCAT(del.lot_id, ', ') as other_lots
FROM reagents r
JOIN cas_max cm ON r.cas_number = cm.cas_number
LEFT JOIN reagents del ON del.cas_number = r.cas_number
WHERE r.quantity >= cm.max_qty
GROUP BY r.lot_id, r.cas_number, r.quantity;

INSERT INTO measurements (session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes)
SELECT p.session_id, p.participant_id, p.condition, p.cognitive_score, p.reaction_ms, p.recorded_at, p.status, p.protocol_note
FROM pilot_sessions p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements m WHERE m.session_id = p.session_id);
WITH pilot_values AS (
  SELECT condition, 'mean_cognitive_score' AS metric, cognitive_score AS value
  FROM measurements WHERE notes LIKE 'SCORE SCALE 0-50%' AND status = 'valid'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT condition, 'mean_reaction_ms' AS metric, reaction_ms AS value
  FROM measurements WHERE notes LIKE 'SCORE SCALE 0-50%' AND status = 'valid'
), summary_rows AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN condition = 'sleep_deprived' AND metric = 'mean_cognitive_score' THEN 'AN-03'
           WHEN condition = 'sleep_deprived' AND metric = 'mean_reaction_ms' THEN 'AN-04'
           WHEN condition = 'rested' AND metric = 'mean_cognitive_score' THEN 'AN-05'
           WHEN condition = 'rested' AND metric = 'mean_reaction_ms' THEN 'AN-06'
         END AS analysis_id,
         metric,
         'pilot_0_50_' || condition AS summary_condition,
         ROUND(AVG(value), 1) AS value,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM pilot_values
  GROUP BY condition, metric
)
INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
SELECT analysis_id, metric, summary_condition, value, n, '2026-10-22', 'Elena Park'
FROM summary_rows
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results_summary r WHERE r.analysis_id = summary_rows.analysis_id);
INSERT INTO changelog (entry_id, author, date, message)
SELECT 'CL-3', 'Elena Park', '2026-10-22', 'integrated 3 pilot sessions into measurements; added pilot-only 0-50 summaries (AN-03 to AN-06) without combining cognitive scores with standard-scale data'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM changelog WHERE entry_id = 'CL-3');

INSERT INTO measurements (session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes)
SELECT p.session_id, p.participant_id, p.condition, p.cognitive_score * 2, p.reaction_ms, p.recorded_at, p.status,
       'Normalized from pilot 0-50 to 0-100; source protocol: ' || p.protocol_note
FROM pilot_sessions p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements m WHERE m.session_id = p.session_id);
UPDATE results_summary
SET value = (SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.cognitive_score), 1) FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid')
WHERE metric = 'mean_cognitive_score'
  AND condition IN ('rested', 'sleep_deprived')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid');
UPDATE results_summary
SET value = (SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.reaction_ms), 1) FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid'),
    n = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid'),
    computed_at = '2026-10-22', author = 'Elena Park'
WHERE metric = 'mean_reaction_ms'
  AND condition IN ('rested', 'sleep_deprived')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid');
UPDATE results_summary
SET n = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid'),
    computed_at = '2026-10-22', author = 'Elena Park'
WHERE metric = 'mean_cognitive_score'
  AND condition IN ('rested', 'sleep_deprived')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements m WHERE m.condition = results_summary.condition AND m.status = 'valid');
INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
SELECT CASE WHEN metric = 'mean_cognitive_score' THEN 'AN-03' ELSE 'AN-04' END,
       metric, condition,
       CASE WHEN metric = 'mean_cognitive_score' THEN (SELECT ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 1) FROM measurements WHERE condition = 'sleep_deprived' AND status = 'valid')
            ELSE (SELECT ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 1) FROM measurements WHERE condition = 'sleep_deprived' AND status = 'valid') END,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements WHERE condition = 'sleep_deprived' AND status = 'valid'),
       '2026-10-22', 'Elena Park'
FROM (SELECT 'mean_cognitive_score' AS metric, 'sleep_deprived' AS condition UNION ALL SELECT 'mean_reaction_ms', 'sleep_deprived') candidates
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results_summary r WHERE r.metric = candidates.metric AND r.condition = candidates.condition);
